note: Wikimedia Commons, “Foka sinopski.jpg”; artist as recorded there: Ikonopisatel — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons files it under “Phocas, Bishop of Sinope” and describes it “Saint Phocas of Sinope … Ortodox icon (fresco)”. This folder's saint is the hieromartyr Phocas, Bishop of Sinope («Сщмч. Фоки, еп. Синопийского»), and the Commons category names that see and that office — not Phocas the Gardener, whose own Commons files are titled “the Gardner”. Commons describes it: Saint Phocas of Sinope, traditionally shown with a book and a paddle. Ortodox icon (fresco).
